action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription to InvoiceModal to remove the React aria-describedby warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/clients uses name as unique key for upsert — consider using P.IVA/codice_fiscale as more robust identity (two clients with same 'ragione sociale' but different P.IVA would collide). For MVP the current behavior matches spec.
uninvoice endpoint does NOT delete the client, only detaches from job — correct behavior (clients persist for reuse).
InvoiceModal invoice_date is auto-prefilled to today via ISO slice — good UX. No validation that date is not in future; acceptable for invoicing.
CompletedFolder computes totaleDaFatturare/totaleFatturato via filter().reduce — small O(n) duplication but fine at this scale.
work-types PUT/POST/DELETE now require get_current_user (any authenticated); team endpoints still require admin — matches spec.
